description: Live Primary Operational Metering 14 Day is a dataset listed in Northern Powergrid open data portal, an open data portal of an electricity distribution network operator, published or maintained by Northern Powergrid. Our Primary Operational Metering contains live data on the power flows through each of our primary substations. Specifically, This is the active power, measured in Kilowatts at half hourly intervals for each of our primary substations, where a primary substation is a substation that converts voltage from EHV (33kV+) down to HV (11 or 20kV). Coverage: Great Britain (network area of the operator or portal owner). The portal flags it as a time series. The portal files it under Network, Connecting Demand. Its keywords are Live Data, High Voltage (HV), Transformer, EHV Substation Data. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Northern Powergrid Open Data Licence v1.0 (https://northernpowergrid.opendatasoft.com/p/opendatalicence/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-npg-open-data-portal.
